gridDNA: Full-bleed textured background, a dominant left-aligned text column in the upper-left, a stylized product presentation with a human hand in the upper-right, and a secondary text line in the lower-left, with a fine print footer.

typeScale: headline ~14% of canvas height, subheadline ~5%, offer ~3.5%, product label ~3%, logo/disclaimer ~1%
colourBlocking: The entire canvas is dominated by a deep, rich red/burgundy background. Text is primarily white. The offer pill is a distinct pink/red, and the product bag is light pink, creating a contrast against the background.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left side of the canvas around the headline and subheadline, allowing the text to breathe and stand out against the dark background. The right side is more occupied by the product, but the background still provides breathing room around it.
eyePath: Logo -> Headline -> Offer -> Product -> Human -> Product Label -> Subheadline -> Disclaimer
whyItWins: The clear left-aligned text hierarchy combined with a visually engaging, stylized product presentation on the right creates a balanced yet dynamic composition that guides the eye efficiently through the offer.
